topic: Harness dispatch economics: shell yield-to-exit, transport asymmetry, premature compaction thresholds
notes:
Peeled from thread-935b467d (wave-6 postmortem + deepseek self-retro, 2026-06-09). Three coupled harness-economics defects affecting every dispatched bro:

1. SHELL YIELD-TO-EXIT (gap-c6dbc03f, updated). shell_run's yield_time_ms does not block to completion: deepseek set yield_time_ms=180000 on an 85s cargo run and still got running:true, forcing a poll turn. Every 60-90s command costs 2 turns; 5-min compiles cost ~35 on poll-happy providers. Call-mix evidence: gpt-5.5/Responses retained window 82/133 calls = shell_poll; deepseek 18 shell_run vs 2 shell_poll. FIX SHAPE: block_until_exit=true mode (single call returns final result) or honor large yield_time_ms to exit. Owner surface: crates/bro-tools shell.

2. TRANSPORT ASYMMETRY (gap-8a6f752c, refined). The deferred-tool-catalog reinjection tax is Responses/brodex-transport-specific: gpt-5.5 sessions burned 7-12K FRESH tokens/turn (catalog arriving nearly every turn, narrated 30-50x/run); deepseek/anthropic-transport burned 0.4-1.3K/turn with catalog "present but low-impact". Investigate WHERE the reinjection happens (openai_responses.rs / responses_common.rs vs anthropic.rs tool-advertisement paths) and hash-gate or once-per-session it on the Responses side.

3. PREMATURE COMPACTION AT STALE THRESHOLDS (root-caused this session). crates/bro-harness/src/compaction.rs default_entries() hardcodes: deepseek-* → 128K window (compact at 0.75 = 96K), claude-*/glm-* → 200K, default → 200K (minimax M3 falls here → 150K trigger). deepseek-v4-pro and MiniMax-M3 both claim 1M context — the harness compacts them at ~10% of capacity. Confirmed cost: deepseek's wave-6 session compacted once mid-run (~50-100K context), ~10% of session time spent re-grounding, and the compaction summary contained one FALSE MEMORY (claimed wave-6b touched routes.rs; it had not) that cost a verification re-read — i.e. premature compaction isn't just latency, it's a correctness hazard. gpt-5.5 (not in catalog → 200K default) also compacted (W4a session has compaction_summary). OPEN QUESTIONS: (a) how is the trigger's token count measured (provider usage vs estimate)? (b) should the provider catalog (orchestration/providers.rs) own per-model windows and pass them through dispatch env via BRO_HARNESS_COMPACTION_CONFIG (which exists but is unwired)? (c) right compact_at for 1M-class models given cache economics (a 700K-token cache-miss turn is expensive — maybe compaction earlier than capacity is DESIRABLE for cost; needs a deliberate policy, not a stale accident).

Related: thread-24220225 (harness-agent-ergonomics), gap-4629bbeb (session observability — timestamps would make all of this measurable). Evidence sessions: 5064b92c (deepseek 6b/6c+retro), a2eb6d49 (gpt-5.5 W4a), 73456b1f (minimax 6a).

CORRECTION (operator review): retract the open-question framing in (c) that "compaction earlier than capacity may be DESIRABLE for cost." That speculation contradicted the evidence cited two paragraphs above it — premature compaction produced a false-memory summary (a correctness hazard) and a ~10% re-grounding tax in the very session under study — and it contradicts the standing order that bros run on subscription and LLM spend is not a constraint to optimize. The default direction for this thread is therefore: per-model context windows raised to actual model capacity (catalog-owned, wired through BRO_HARNESS_COMPACTION_CONFIG at dispatch), with compaction as a last-resort overflow guard, not a tuning knob. Any future proposal to compact below capacity needs affirmative evidence of net benefit on quality grounds (e.g. demonstrated long-context degradation for a specific model), not cost reasoning. The remaining legitimate open questions are (a) how the trigger counts tokens (provider usage vs estimate) and (b) the catalog/env wiring mechanics.

Provider-catalog wiring via BRO_HARNESS_COMPACTION_CONFIG remains optional refinement (model-keyed defaults suffice for in-process dispatch since env is process-global).

CODE-GROUNDING PASS (2026-06-10, beta/blackbox-v2 @ 3e64be8) — verified each remaining item against code:

1. SHELL PROCESS-GROUP REAPING (gap-43059df9): FULLY OPEN, structurally unaddressed. bro-tools/src/shell.rs spawns bash via tokio::process::Command with kill_on_drop(true) but NO process-group setup (no process_group(0)/setsid) (:438-452). All kill paths are single-pid: timeout kill child.kill() (:167-179), signal_child positive-pid libc::kill (:277-284), shell_kill (:709-716), overflow start_kill (:524-530), kill_on_drop. Backgrounded grandchildren (sccache/rustc) survive every path. Test backgrounded_pipe_holder_does_not_hang (:1132-1152) acknowledges the problem but only bounds the pipe-drain hang (READER_DRAIN_GRACE 2s); no reaping. Fix shape: process_group(0) at spawn + negative-pid/killpg on every kill path.

2. EXEC-CELL YIELD TIMER (gap-c6dbc03f residual): OPEN, confirmed. bro-code-mode/src/service.rs yield timer init :616-618, reset-on-poll :756, fires :801-809; defaults 10s (runtime/mod.rs:25-26 DEFAULT_EXEC/WAIT_YIELD_TIME_MS). A nested shell_poll with long yield_time_ms races the cell timer and the cell yields first with partial output. Mitigation exists but must be known up-front: @exec pragma {"yield_time_ms":N} (description.rs:20). No code-mode commits since a6421c5. Fix shape options: extend cell deadline while a nested tool call is in flight, or surface the pragma in pinned code_mode guidance.

3. GLM Z.AI BUILTINS (gap-c21e34a3 facet 1): KNOB EXISTS, DEFAULTS WRONG WAY, UNWIRED PER-LANE. TurnOpts.web_search (transport/mod.rs:302-318) gates injection of web_search_20250305 into the tools array (anthropic.rs:58-84); controlled by BRO_HARNESS_WEB_SEARCH, default TRUE (agent_loop.rs:595-597). So the harness REQUESTS server-side search on the glm lane by default — the d98ee38a flail is plausibly self-inflicted. Candidate fix: set BRO_HARNESS_WEB_SEARCH=0 in glm lane env (brofile.rs default_claude_compatible_env :404-436 / resolve_provider_env) for dispatched code bros, then live-verify Z.ai stops firing web_search_prime when the tool is omitted. Facet 2 (exec-note discoverability) tracked in thread-24220225.

4. SESSION OBSERVABILITY (gap-4629bbeb): two facets DONE, two REMAIN. DONE: BRO_HOME routing (server/open.rs:171-175 sets BRO_HOME at daemon startup; session.rs:62-71 sessions_dir → BRO_HOME/harness-sessions) and atomic writes (session.rs:88-109 write_atomic tmp+rename, all 5 agent_loop call sites, tests). 5. BRO_HARNESS_COMPACTION_CONFIG: read in compaction.rs:84-102 (env var = path to JSON BTreeMap<model-glob, {context_window, compact_at}>) but UNWIRED on the daemon dispatch side (no reference in resolve_provider_env). default_entries (compaction.rs:163-195) confirms the 318fcef table: deepseek-v4*/MiniMax-M* 1M, gpt-5* 400K, deepseek-* 128K, claude-*/glm-* 200K, default 200K@0.75 — model-keyed defaults are correct, so wiring remains optional.
